content: Hey Laura, I was just thinking about you. It's been a long day out here, but your messages always make me smile.
That means a lot to me, Tom. It gets lonely here too, but talking to you makes it better.
I wish I could be there to make you a cup of tea and listen to you in person. I promise, when this contract is over, I'll come see you.
I'd really like that. It's been so long since someone wanted to spend time with me just for me.
You deserve all the attention and care in the world, Laura. I hope you know how special you are to me.
You're so sweet, Tom. I don't know what I'd do without our talks.
Honestly, you keep me going. Work's been extra tough this week. We're stuck offshore longer than I expected, and now there's an issue with my leave paperwork.
Oh no, is everything okay? That sounds really stressful.
It's frustrating. The company changed their process, and now they're saying I need to pay a leave request fee before they approve my time off. My salary is still pending, so I'm in a bind.
That's terrible. Is there anything I can do to help?

I hate even asking, but you're the only one I trust. If you could help me cover the $2,450 fee, I'll pay you back the moment I'm onshore and get my pay. I can send the payment details if you're willing.
I want to help, but that's a lot of money. Are you sure there's no other way?
I completely understand your hesitation. I would never ask if it weren't urgent. I promise on my honor, I'll pay you back as soon as I can. You mean so much to me, Laura.
I trust you, Tom. How do I send the money?

Thank you, Laura. You're a lifesaver. The finance office accepts wire transfers. Here are the details: Bank name is 'Global Trust Bank', routing number 084009519, account number 44217739. Please let me know once you've sent it, so I can confirm with them.
Okay, I'll try to do it after work. Just want to help you get home sooner.
You have no idea how much this means to me. I can't wait to finally hold you and thank you in person.
I hope it all works out. Let me know if you need anything else, okay?
Absolutely. You're the only one I could count on in this situation. I promise I'll make this up to you, Laura.
Just be safe out there, Tom. I'm looking forward to us being together soon.
